verdict.rationale: Company formation is a fair question for a full-service law firm, so the axis applies. The pack does not document an incorporation or emerging-companies service covering charter, bylaws, initial board consents or founder stock purchase. The firm lists start-ups among its clients and publishes a startup-notification analysis, but neither describes engaging it to incorporate a company. Its fund-vehicle formation work is a different capability and does not count here.

support.subject: As a founder, I can engage the firm to incorporate my company — charter, bylaws, initial board consents, and founder stock purchase — documented as a core of its startup/emerging-companies practice
